targets.query:
from(bucket: "vkr_pak")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vkr_motor_telemetry")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "torque")
  |> group(columns: ["axis"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "torque")

from(bucket: "vkr_pak")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vkr_rul_estimates")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "HI")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.axis == "motor1")
  |> group(columns: ["scenario"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "HI")

from(bucket: "vkr_pak")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vkr_rul_estimates")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "RUL_pred")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.axis == "motor1")
  |> group(columns: ["scenario"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "RUL_pred")

from(bucket: "vkr_pak")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vkr_nn_rul_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "RUL_nn_pred")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.split == "live" or r.split == "test")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.axis == "motor1")
  |> group(columns: ["scenario", "split"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "RUL_nn_pred")

from(bucket: "vkr_pak")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vkr_nn_rul_predictions")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "abs_error")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.split == "live" or r.split == "test")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.axis == "motor1")
  |> group(columns: ["scenario", "split"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "NN abs error")

from(bucket: "vkr_pak")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vkr_nn_rul_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "MAE")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.split == "test")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.axis == "motor1")
  |> group(columns: ["scenario"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "NN test MAE")

from(bucket: "vkr_pak")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "vkr_nn_rul_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "R2")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.split == "test")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.axis == "motor1")
  |> group(columns: ["scenario"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "NN test R2")
